description: Use this when the user needs the status of an existing asynchronous Freebeat task. Supports task IDs from generate_music_video, generate_dance_video, generate_lyric_video, music, singing, lip-sync, and effect tools, plus Open RPC image/video batch IDs. Polling a song-driven video may start its final video assembly from already generated assets; it does not regenerate source assets. Song-driven video jobs report running, completed, failed, or action_required; while running, relay the latest step named in message; completed videos include video_url, and on action_required read get_video_session with this task_id and use send_video_agent_message to continue the conversation in either auto or co-create mode. For Open RPC batches, result URLs are returned on completed items; do not call get_task_result for these batches. For other tasks call get_task_result after completed, failed, or action_required. On failures or pauses, explain failure.stage, failure.reason, failure.retryable and billing charged/refunded/net/refund_state; null means not reported, and pending refunds are not refunded credits.

serial_no.description: Optional Open RPC item serial number for querying one batch item.

task_id.description: Task ID returned by a generation tool

name: get_task_status

outputSchema.description: On success, returns the tool result fields. On error, returns success:false, error and code, with optional credit approval details; success-only fields are absent.

batch_id.description: Open RPC batch id when task_type is open_rpc_batch.

error_message.description: Backend failure message when the task status is failed.

items.description: Open RPC batch item statuses and result URLs.

message.description: A human-readable summary of the current task state.

session_url.description: For agent videos, the freebeat.ai page where the user can watch, review, or continue the session.

status.description: The normalized task status; unrecognized upstream values become unknown.

anyOf.description: Whether the task status was retrieved successfully.

task_id.description: The asynchronous task ID being queried.

task_type.description: The normalized task category derived from the Freebeat session type.

video_url.description: The playable final video URL when the task is completed.
